manifest.name: Sale Loyalty
manifest.summary: Use discounts and loyalty programs in sales orders

models._description: Sale Order Coupon Points - Keeps track of how a sale order impacts a coupon
_inherit sale.order: carries applied coupons, code-enabled rules, the coupon point ledger and reward amount
_inherit sale.order.line: reward / discount / free-product line carrying the coupon and points cost
_inherit loyalty.card: links the issued card/coupon back to its source sale.order
_inherit loyalty.program: order_count rollup + sale_ok channel flag
_inherit loyalty.reward: tunes discount backing-product values for SO invoicing, archives instead of unlink when used
_inherit loyalty.history: resolves the sale.order portal URL for history rows
_inherit account.move.line: marks invoice lines backed by a discount reward line as discount lines

behavioral_notes.observation: The 'Add a promo/coupon code' wizard (sale.loyalty.coupon.wizard) calls order._try_apply_code(code). That method first searches loyalty.rule for mode='with_code', code=<input> within _get_trigger_domain(); if no program-rule matches it falls back to a loyalty.card whose code equals the input (validating active program, reward_ids, program_domain, expiration and remaining points). It rejects already-applied codes, blocks 'loyalty'/'ewallet' program types ('cannot be applied with code'), and locks the loyalty_program row via raw SQL 'SELECT id FROM loyalty_program WHERE id=%s FOR UPDATE NOWAIT' to force a serialization retry under concurrency. On success it appends the rule to code_enabled_rule_ids and/or the coupon to applied_coupon_ids, runs _try_apply_program / _update_programs_and_rewards, and returns _get_claimable_rewards; the wizard then opens sale.loyalty.reward.wizard pre-loaded with those rewards. None of this code-vs-coupon resolution or row-locking is visible in metadata.

_update_programs_and_rewards is the engine that reconciles the order against its programs. STEP 1 auto-loads the partner's eWallet and 'future' loyalty cards with positive points into applied_coupon_ids, gathers points/coupon/automatic programs (trigger='auto', rule mode='auto', under max_usage), drops expired coupons and re-checks domains via _program_check_compute_points. STEP 2 then regenerates reward order lines: _get_reward_line_values dispatches to _get_reward_values_discount (creates one sale.order.line per tax bucket on the reward's discount_line_product_id, name=reward.description, tax_ids cleared, discount split via _discountable_order/_specific/_cheapest and capped at discount_max_amount and the order total) or _get_reward_values_product (a free-product line priced so points cover required_points * claimable_count). Lines are written in a single order_line write (Command.UPDATE/CREATE/DELETE) keyed by reward_identifier_code, with is_reward_line lines excluded from name/discount/tax recompute and from being invoiced alone. This regenerate-on-every-change flow is pure behavior.

behavioral_notes.element: sale.order.action_confirm -> point debit/credit on loyalty.card + loyalty.history
behavioral_notes.observation: On confirmation action_confirm raises ValidationError if any coupon would end with negative points, calls _update_programs_and_rewards then _add_loyalty_history_lines (creates loyalty.history rows per coupon recording 'issued' = coupon_point_ids.points and 'used' = sum of reward line points_cost), unlinks ghost 'current' coupons that claimed no reward, and applies _get_point_changes() (issued points minus reward points_cost) onto each loyalty.card.points so the card balance moves only at confirm time. If the single order still has unclaimed rewards it returns a 'Rewards Available' display_notification, and _send_reward_coupon_mail fires the creation communication for any reward coupons generated for future orders. _action_cancel reverses all of this (deletes history, subtracts points back, removes reward lines and non-nominative coupons). sale.order.line.create/write/unlink additionally adjust coupon.points live when a confirmed order's reward lines change. The card is a passive balance in loyalty itself; sale_loyalty is the consumer that actually moves the points.

sale.loyalty.reward.wizard computes claimable rewards via order._get_claimable_rewards() (grouped per coupon, filtering expired coupons, already-applied discounts, zero-total orders without a payment reward, inactive reward products and best-global-discount-already-applied). action_apply locates the coupon owning the selected reward, calls order._apply_program_reward(reward, coupon, product=selected_product_id) (which checks required_points and best-global-discount, then writes the reward line), re-runs _update_programs_and_rewards and prunes unused 'current' coupons. For a one-reward / one-coupon non-multi-product case sale.order.action_open_reward_wizard short-circuits and applies the reward directly without opening the dialog.

1 JS file, 1 XML template, 1 OWL component (LoyaltyDataField) registered as field widget 'loyalty_data_field' in web.assets_backend; 0 patches, 0 services, 0 public interactions. The widget renders the sale.order.loyalty_data Json field (a read-only points/rewards summary block) on the order form. No storefront/public assets here (that is website_sale_loyalty).

it_architecture.application: sale_loyalty (Sale Loyalty bridge application component, auto-installed by sale + loyalty)
logical_data_erm: loyalty.reward -> product.product (discount_line_product_id, the reward line product)
information_flows: side-effect: sale.order._try_apply_code -> resolves a loyalty.rule code or loyalty.card, locks loyalty.program row (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE NOWAIT)
side-effect: sale.order._update_programs_and_rewards -> regenerates reward sale.order.line rows (discount / free product) from loyalty.reward + loyalty.rule
side-effect: sale.order.action_confirm -> debits/credits loyalty.card.points and writes loyalty.history (issued/used); cancel reverses it
side-effect: sale.order.action_confirm -> _send_reward_coupon_mail issues creation communication for future-order reward coupons (gift cards / next-order coupons)
consumes: loyalty (program/rule/reward/card engine) — sale_loyalty is the sale.order-side application of that engine

capabilities: Apply Promotions & Discounts to Sales Orders (automatic and promo-code rules)
Redeem Coupons / Gift Cards / eWallets on a Sales Order
Generate Reward Order Lines (percentage / fixed / per-point discounts and free products)
Earn & Settle Loyalty Points on Order Confirmation (debit/credit loyalty.card)
Issue Reward Coupons from a Sales Order with customer communication
value_streams: Promotion-on-order: capture order -> apply auto/coded program -> generate reward/discount lines -> confirm -> settle points & history & issue follow-on coupons
(the discounts/rewards leg of the quote-to-cash flow inherited from sale; full lifecycle realized with the loyalty engine)
products: product.product (loyalty.reward.discount_line_product_id reward backing product; sale_loyalty forces invoice_policy='order' and clears taxes on it)
policies: 17 access rules; no own record rules (multi-company scoping inherited from sale / loyalty)
one promo code applied once per order; 'loyalty'/'ewallet' programs cannot be applied by code
loyalty_program row locked (FOR UPDATE NOWAIT) during code application to serialize concurrent usage
negative-points guard on confirmation (action_confirm raises if any reward overspends a coupon)
UNIQUE(order_id, coupon_id) on sale.order.coupon.points; reward lines cannot be invoiced alone or edited on portal
stakeholders: Sales user / salesperson applying promotions on the quotation
Customer (res.partner) redeeming coupons / gift cards / earning points
Marketing configuring the loyalty programs consumed here
Accounting (discount reward lines flow into account.move.line as discount lines)
metrics: sale.order.reward_amount (total discount/reward value on the order)
loyalty.program.order_count / total_order_count (sales orders that used the program)
sale.order.gift_card_count; loyalty.history issued/used per card per order

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: sale_loyalty is the promotions/discounts-and-rewards layer of the Quote-to-Cash (sale) value chain: it operates directly on the confirmed sale.order, generating reward/discount order lines, settling loyalty points and issuing follow-on coupons at confirmation. Unlike the loyalty engine (classified support — a cross-cutting program/rule/reward definition store), this module is part of the primary sell motion: it changes what the customer pays on a real order and is auto-installed precisely to graft that pricing behavior onto sale's chain. Hence value_model=chain, activity_class=primary. Its subject matter is pricing & promotions on orders, mapping to APQC 3.0 Market and Sell (3.2 develop pricing strategy / manage promotions) applied at order time, consistent with the parent loyalty record and apqc_odoo_map.tsv (3.2.2.x pricing on sale).

standard_capabilities: Apply a coupon / promo code to a sales order via the Apply Coupon wizard (sale.loyalty.coupon.wizard)
Auto-apply automatic promotion programs (trigger=auto, rule mode=auto) when the order qualifies
Select and claim rewards via the Reward Selection wizard, including multi-product and global-discount handling
Generate discount reward lines (percent / fixed per_order / per_point, on order / specific / cheapest) and free-product lines
Auto-load and pay with a customer's eWallet / loyalty-card points and settle balances on confirmation
Issue gift cards / next-order coupons from the order and email the creation communication
Show a loyalty points/rewards summary (loyalty_data) on the order form
typical_fits: percentage and fixed discounts auto-applied or entered as a promo code on quotations
gift cards and eWallets redeemed as payment on back-office sales orders
buy-X-get-Y and next-order coupon promotions on confirmed orders
points earned per order/spend feeding a customer's loyalty card
common_gaps: storefront / eCommerce application of the same programs (handled by website_sale_loyalty, not here)
Point-of-Sale redemption (pos_loyalty), a separate consumer of the loyalty engine
bespoke discount math beyond percent / per_order / per_point modes
tiered membership status or external loyalty-platform synchronization (no outbound integration in this module)
drive_hints: odoo shell: so = env['sale.order'].search([], limit=1); w = env['sale.loyalty.coupon.wizard'].create({'order_id': so.id, 'coupon_code': 'PROMO'}); w.action_apply()

open_questions: Exact precedence when multiple automatic programs and a coded program compete for the same lines (ordering inside _update_programs_and_rewards STEP 2).
Concurrency behavior of the FOR UPDATE NOWAIT program lock under high-volume promo-code application (retry storms).
Lifecycle of reward sale.order.line rows across order copy / amendment after confirmation (copy() drops them; partial re-confirmation paths).
How point settlement interacts with down-payments and zero-total invoicing (_validate_order force-invoices zero-total reward orders).
